item.text: {"groups":[{"member_ids":["4fb401f3ca86d7e2303a","b6aa6b60dc280f699747"],"operation":"Streaming compression through ZSTD_compressStream2","condition":"FUZZ_randomCParams selects a strategy whose compressor may be excluded by the build.","capability":"ZSTD_adjustCParams_internal and ZSTD_selectBlockCompressor must resolve that strategy to a callable included compressor.","consequence":"Streaming compression or its round trip fails.","equivalence_reason":"Both describe the same strategy adjustment and compressor dispatch hypothesis under build exclusions."},{"member_ids":["078219e3c8afa5dc95ae","ce8a2495ff126b58ecfc","987d3c7a41f5b5c7a4da"],"operation":"Dictionary-loaded streaming compression and decompression","condition":"A valid dictionary is supplied for a streaming round trip.","capability":"Context setup through ZSTD_CCtx_loadDictionary or ZSTD_CCtx_refCDict must reach ZSTD_loadDictionaryContent and dictionary-aware ZSTD_selectBlockCompressor dispatch, with corresponding dictionary setup for decompression.","consequence":"The target cannot exercise a dictionary-backed streaming round trip.","equivalence_reason":"All three describe reachability of the same dictionary-loaded streaming path through context setup."},{"member_ids":["230b08efc58f6dc3ed66"],"operation":"Streaming compression with a high window or hash log","condition":"A supported configuration has windowLog or hashLog above 15.","capability":"FUZZ_randomCParams must generate parameters that reach that configuration through ZSTD_adjustCParams_internal.","consequence":"The target does not exercise that streaming configuration.","equivalence_reason":"This configuration reachability hypothesis has no equivalent candidate in the packet."}]}
